name: Tears of the Moon
summary: At the Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora mourns Lady Sathrah's madness. Once cherished by Elune, the great spider has become dangerous, and the Sisterhood seeks to end her suffering and recover her sacred spinnerets.

sections.title: A Beloved Creature's Fall
sections.body: In Darnassus's Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora grieves for Lady Sathrah. Sathrah was once blessed by Elune. Beneath the night sky, she wove delicate silver webs that caught the evening mist on Teldrassil's boughs. The Sisterhood of Elune gathered and kept the shimmering dew from those webs, which held healing powers for their sacred ministrations.

sections.title: Mercy for Sathrah
sections.body: Like much of the wildlife on the young World Tree, Lady Sathrah has recently fallen into madness. Her corruption threatens travelers and her own unhatched broods near Wellspring Lake in the northern reaches. The Sisterhood cannot cleanse her while she roams in a violent frenzy, so they have decided that ending her suffering is the only compassionate path. They mean to retrieve her silvery spinnerets and dedicate her remains at Elune's altar, praying the Moon Goddess grants her peace and a pure rebirth.

faq.answer: Lady Sathrah is an ancient spider native to Teldrassil, once beloved of Elune. Her silvery webs caught the night mist, whose dew was known for its healing power.

faq.q: Why does Lady Sathrah have to be killed?
faq.answer: Lady Sathrah has fallen into a madness that has spread through Teldrassil's wildlife. Violent and dangerous to her offspring and others, she is to be slain as an act of mercy.
Lady Sathrah is found in northern Teldrassil, near the shores of Wellspring Lake.

faq.q: What were Lady Sathrah's webs used for?
faq.answer: Lady Sathrah's webs caught the evening mist, forming silvery dew with healing powers. The Sisterhood of Elune kept it in the Temple of the Moon.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Tears of the Moon?
aliases: who gives tears of the moon
tears of the moon quest giver
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora gives Tears of the Moon from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus to trusted Alliance adventurers.

faq.q: What will the priestesses do with Sathrah's spinnerets?
faq.answer: The priestesses plan to offer Sathrah's spinnerets to Elune at the temple altar. They ask the goddess to accept Sathrah's spirit, bless her, and grant her a peaceful rebirth.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you know corruption in Teldrassil's wilds spares neither humble beasts nor Elune's sacred companions.
As a priest of the Sisterhood of Elune, you know mercy can call for a sorrowful strike and a ritual offering to return a corrupted soul to the Goddess's embrace.
As a druid, you see Sathrah's sudden ferocity and torment as another troubling sign of Teldrassil's imbalance. Restoring her spirit is an ecological necessity.
